evidence.description: Section 3 begins Sample A table construction.
SQL creates the exact SMPL_E output table and preserves its stated conditions.
evidence.quote:
/* Create Sample E */
WITH SMPL_E_1 AS
(
SELECT			*
FROM			SMPL_E_VARIABLES
WHERE			FISCAL_YEAR >= 2008
			AND	FISCAL_YEAR <= 2015
			AND	EXEMPT       = 0
)
SELECT			A.*                                                        ,
				L_INST_MANDATORY_AUDIT_SHARE = B.INST_MANDATORY_AUDIT_SHARE,
				L_MANDATORY_AUDIT_SHARE      = B.MANDATORY_AUDIT_SHARE    
INTO			SMPL_E
FROM			SMPL_E_1 AS A
			LEFT OUTER JOIN
				SMPL_E_1 AS B
			ON	A.STATE    = B.STATE
			AND	A.ACTIVITY = B.ACTIVITY
			AND	(A.FISCAL_YEAR - B.FISCAL_YEAR) = 1
WHERE			A.IN_SMPL_A                  = 1
			AND	A.DONATIONS_5K			     IS NOT NULL
			AND	B.INST_MANDATORY_AUDIT_SHARE IS NOT NULL 
;
